$265,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,704 SF, MLS# 595521

This beautiful home has been lovingly cared for by its owner! Three spacious bedrooms and two full baths with 1704 sq. ft., an open floor plan, and high ceilings, makes this home such a gem! The fireplace in the family room is large and will definitely keep you warm on cool days. A separate dining room is great for family and friend gatherings during holidays and celebrations. The kitchen has updated appliances, and plenty of cabinet space. 
Soak in the garden/spa tub after a long day at work, or take a quick shower in the updated separate shower. 
Enjoy the covered patio on pretty days and listen to the birds singing. This home is immaculate and is move in ready! Enjoy the upcoming holidays in this home.

2 full bath
